title: fm-sol-control/v2
$comment: THE single source of truth for the clean-room control plane. Producer validation, consumer validation and the human reply-contract projection are all derived from THIS FILE and from nothing else. No field name may be typed by a human or an agent anywhere: not in a request body, not in an issue body, not in a brief, not in a prompt, not in a diagnostic. Evolved from fm-sol-control/v1 (artifacts/plans/sol-control-v1.md, artifacts/plans/proofs-shared-contracts.md) with v1 CHANGE 1-6 applied, the canonical provenance ruling 19/5505694096 encoded structurally, and the captain control-config-generation addendum of 2026-09-02 bound into every envelope. The protocol string is deliberately NOT fm-sol-control/v1: the retired venue already owns that string over a different envelope (sol-control-v1.md section 9).

verdict_class.$comment: Folded under the precedence FAIL > CNO > PASS. There is no continue-with-a-warning value. An empty result set, an unreadable record, an absent artifact, an unreachable tool and a silent verifier are all CNO and none of them is PASS.

id_derivation.$comment: MACHINE-READABLE DERIVATION INPUTS, and the authoritative statement of every derived identity. The compiler and the consumer READ this object out of the schema and hash the named field values in the order given; they do not carry their own list of field names. Each id is 'prefix' followed by the first 32 hex characters of sha256 over the resolved values joined by LF with one trailing LF. A dotted input is a path into the envelope; a null or absent value resolves to the empty string.

protocol_string.$comment: Compared by EXACT STRING EQUALITY, never by substring or prefix. 'fm-sol-control/v2' contains 'fm-sol-control', so a consumer matching on word overlap would consume retired-venue v1 traffic. See venue_isolation.match_rule in the canonical control config.

request_id.$comment: EXPLICIT AND STABLE. Derived, never assigned; the inputs and their order are owned by $defs.id_derivation in this file and are read from there rather than transcribed. Recompiling the same request at the same generations yields the same id, so 'have I already asked this?' is a lookup and not a judgement; any generation moving yields a DIFFERENT id, so a stale ruling cannot even address the new subject.

ruling_id.$comment: EXPLICIT AND UNIQUE, assigned by the ruler and unique across the ruler's whole lineage. Not derived by us: it is the ruler's own handle for its ruling, and supersedes/in_reply_to chains are built from it. Two rulings sharing one ruling_id are a lineage fork.

receipt_id.$comment: Derived; inputs and order owned by $defs.id_derivation. The receipt identity is therefore a function of exactly what was consumed, so a second consumption of the same ruling cannot produce a different receipt identity.

correlation_id.$comment: Derived; inputs and order owned by $defs.id_derivation. Venue unit is one issue per correlation_id, which bounds the comment universe so the completeness predicate is cheap and always satisfiable.

consumption_key.$comment: REPLAY / CONSUMPTION IDENTITY. Derived; inputs and order owned by $defs.id_derivation. Consumption is at-most-once PER THIS KEY. A consumer that finds a durable record for this key performs ZERO action and returns the first outcome unchanged; it never re-applies, never re-posts and never re-closes.

repo_ref.$comment: EXACT repository identity. owner and name are compared as exact strings; url is redundant transport convenience and is never the comparison axis.

git_point.$comment: EXACT head sha and EXACT tree sha. Identity, never ancestry: a ruling made about abc123 does not apply to a descendant of abc123. Where base_sha is present the compiler must additionally have observed base_sha != head_sha and that the diff resolves non-empty (v1 CHANGE 2, INSTR-1).

evidence_ref.$comment: THE LOCATOR LAW. locator MUST be content-addressed or immutable and is refused otherwise: the accepted forms are a blob/raw/tree URL AT A 40-HEX COMMIT, a commit URL, an issue or issue-comment permalink, an api.github.com URL, a bare numeric check-run or workflow-run id, or a file: capture path. A BRANCH OR TAG URL IS STRUCTURALLY UNREPRESENTABLE: every accepted pattern either pins a 40-hex commit or names an immutable numeric object, so '.../blob/main/x' matches nothing. No pattern admits whitespace, so a locator carrying prose is refused (v1 CHANGE 3, P-B-CAP-4). The locator MUST name the object its sha256 names; where the addressable object and the hashed object genuinely differ, the honest form is kind=api_capture over the captured bytes.

session_ref.$comment: NON-CREDENTIAL DESCRIPTOR. Canonical provenance ruling SOL-FM-AUTHORITY-WRITER-PROVENANCE-CLAIMS-ARE-NOT-EVIDENCE-20260902-G5 (sbracewell64/firstmate-sol-control issue 19, comment 5505694096): session_ref, from, role, kind, automation/process/pane labels, model or provider labels, authority strings and transport-account identity are CLAIMS or METADATA unless an independently authoritative owner binds them to the exact producing execution identity. A self-asserted session_ref is non-credential; it MAY describe an actor and it can NEVER narrow an independence could-not-observe. Carrying it is permitted and is never, on its own, evidence.

provenance_class.$comment: self_asserted_descriptor is the only honest value for anything the producer wrote about itself. forge_recorded_binding is admissible ONLY when forge_binding is present and names a field the FORGE writes, which the evaluated producer could not manufacture.

forge_binding.$comment: The forge-recorded credential path (v1 CHANGE 6). This is a fact THE FORGE WRITES about a comment, readable by any third party at the locator, and not a string the producer chose. It is the only class of evidence that may support narrowing an independence CNO, and even then it establishes a distinct CREDENTIAL PATH, never a distinct PRINCIPAL.

narrowing_evidence_class.$comment: A ONE-VALUE ENUM ON PURPOSE. There is no value here for a self-asserted narrowing, so 'I narrowed my own could-not-observe because I say I am independent' is not merely disallowed, it is UNSPELLABLE and fails validation as RULING_MALFORMED naming this field. This is ruling 19/5505694096 encoded structurally rather than as prose a reviewer must remember.

observation.$comment: Three-valued, always. Narrowing a could-not-observe requires ALL of narrowing_reason, narrowing_evidence_class and an owner-bound narrowing_binding, together; a narrowing that cites no independently verifiable owner-bound evidence cannot be expressed.

control_config_generation.$comment: Captain addendum, 2026-09-02. ONE canonical owner names the protocol, the control repository, the logical Browser Sol project and the routing metadata; ONE deterministic resolver normalizes it; digest = sha256 over the canonical normalized bytes. Every envelope carries the generation it was compiled against. At consumption the consumer FRESHLY RE-RESOLVES the current effective config and compares: a mismatch means the ruling stays historical evidence with outcome REFUSED_STALE_CONFIG and ZERO action. resolver_digest is the sha256 of the resolver itself, so an emitter and a watcher resolving through different resolver bytes is detectable rather than assumed away.

acceptance_policy.$comment: The acceptance policy in force for this decision, as a named generation and a digest over its exact inputs. Compared by identity at consumption; a moved policy digest is RULING_SUPERSEDED and needs a new request, which is a different fact and a different repair from a moved subject head.

identity_line.$comment: The EXACT SUBJECT, as one canonical line that both sides compare by string identity. For a document_package it is the sorted 'sha256  relative_path' manifest digest; for a candidate_branch it is 'owner/name@head_sha^{tree_sha}'. Ruling applicability is exact: applies_to.subject_identity_line must EQUAL this.

valid_while.$comment: THE STALENESS LADDER'S INPUTS. All are identity comparisons against LIVE reads at consumption. evidence_digest is sha256 over the canonical sorted list of 'kind\tlocator\tsha256' triples, one per line, LF-terminated: a ruling bound to a request id is not thereby bound to the evidence its ruler was shown (v1 CHANGE 4).

reply_contract.$comment: GENERATED by walking this file. No pre-filled ruling skeleton is ever shipped: supplying the phrasing supplies a template, and a template can be filled without the underlying fact becoming true (v1 CHANGE 1). The renderer self-checks by re-rendering after posting and byte-comparing.

work_id.$comment: The durable identity of the WORK this decision belongs to, stable across every request generation about it.

project.$comment: The logical project. Routing and diagnostic metadata only: it is NEVER proof of ruler identity or authority. Authority is grounded in the typed ruling, exact request parentage, forge venue and identity evidence, and fresh applicability checks.

work_generation.$comment: Increments when the WORK's own subject or acceptance contract moves. A ruling naming an older work_generation is inapplicable.

request_generation.$comment: Increments per re-ask within one work_generation, e.g. after INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. A ruling naming an older request_generation is inapplicable.

venue.$comment: The CONTROL venue this request is posted in. Must equal the repository resolved from the canonical control config; a request compiled for any other venue is refused before emission.

in_reply_to.$comment: MUST equal the request's request_id, by exact string equality. This is the explicit parentage: a ruling that does not name its parent request is not a ruling about it, however plausible its prose.

applies_to.$comment: EXACT RULING APPLICABILITY. Every field is copied from the request and compared by identity, never by ancestry, containment or plausibility. A disagreement on the subject is RULING_SUBJECT_MISMATCH; a disagreement on the policy digest is RULING_SUPERSEDED; a disagreement on the control config generation is REFUSED_STALE_CONFIG. The three never share a code, because they have three different repairs.

inspection.$comment: The ruler records WHICH evidence locators it actually resolved and read, and its own observations three-valued INCLUDING anything it could not observe. Under-claiming here is the honest shape; a ruling claiming every ref is the shape a fabricated ruling has.

directive.$comment: Closed and total over the reachable answers. THERE IS NO FIELD FOR A THIRD OPTION: the only way to reject every offered option is REJECT_ALL_WITH_CONSTRAINT, which produces no change and hands the constraint back. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is the ruler's could-not-observe and OUT_OF_SCOPE_CAPTAIN_RESERVED is the ruler correcting our boundary predicate; both are SUCCESSFUL round trips.

single_writer_assertion.$comment: The ruler asserting it is the only writer for this correlation id. A second ruling then contradicts an explicit claim rather than merely existing. An intentional replacement names the prior ruling_id in supersedes; two rulings that do not name each other are a LINEAGE FORK, which is a CNO: neither is consumed, both are preserved, and explicit supersession is required.

ruling_sha256.$comment: Taken over the POSTED bytes, never over a local file. A local envelope and a forge-rendered body are canonically identical but not byte-identical; hashing the posted bytes is what makes the record joinable by a third party.

consumption_count.$comment: AT MOST ONCE, structurally: the maximum is 1, so a record claiming a second consumption cannot be expressed.

replay_check.$comment: The replay proof, in the record rather than in prose: a second consumption was ACTUALLY attempted, it performed exactly zero actions, and it returned the identical outcome. A replay check that was not run cannot be reported as passed, because every field here is a const the attempt has to satisfy.

validation.$comment: THE WHOLE LADDER, pass or fail, every predicate evaluated and none skipped. Every failing predicate is reported, not only the first.

applied.$comment: The directive-to-action map is pre-registered, total over the directive enum, with no default branch and no fallback. No step reads the rationale and decides what to write.

outcome.$comment: CONSUMPTION OUTCOME, closed and total over every reachable terminal. EVERY terminal state produces a receipt, refusals and withdrawals included: a refusal that leaves no receipt is a silently abandoned request. REFUSED_STALE_CONFIG is the captain addendum's terminal for a ruling bound to a prior control-config generation: the ruling stays historical evidence and zero action is taken. NO_ANSWER (nothing arrived before expires_at) is recorded APART from INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, which is an answer.

control_config.$comment: The canonical control-plane configuration contract, owned by THIS FILE so that no field name lives in two places. The canonical owner INSTANCE is runtime/firstmate/config/control-plane.yaml; the single deterministic resolver normalizes it and every emitter, watcher, consumer, receipt writer, diagnostic and bootstrap check consumes that resolved representation rather than reimplementing it.
